blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified at Ethereum block 26082914. Sole catalogued USDN token 0xde17a000ba631c5d7c2bd9fb692efea52d90dee2 is non-proxy, with zero EIP-1967 implementation/admin/beacon slots; verified code has no transfer pause, blacklist, seizure or allowance-free arbitrary-holder burn. burnSharesFrom and transferSharesFrom spend allowance even for MINTER_ROLE/REBASER_ROLE callers; a read-only one-share burn from 0xdead impersonating the protocol reverted for insufficient allowance. Active MINTER_ROLE and REBASER_ROLE are held by protocol 0x656cb8c6d154aad29d8771384089be5b5141f01a, whose EIP-1967 implementation is 0x271df5517a4daacb7cab988aa64d23debda4c498, with zero admin/beacon slots and source-confirmed role-gated UUPS upgrades. Protocol defaultAdmin() is the 2-of-3 Safe 0x1e3e1128f6bc2264a19d7a065982696d356879c5 and defaultAdminDelay() is zero. A read-only eth_call impersonating the protocol successfully changed the token divisor from 806169271587050476 to 403084635793525238 through rebase(), whereas an unrelated caller reverted. The immutable token clamps rebases to increase balances globally: the protocol cannot reduce or block holder balances, selectively seize shares, or bypass transfer/burn allowances through this role. Rebase callbacks are not invoked on ordinary transfers. Protocol upgrades, mint authority and this increase-only rebase therefore do not establish a mutable holder restriction or justify possible. Token DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by non-proxy SetRebaseHandlerManager 0x31911dbc5274e76b0facedcf07de4bf7e859e245, owned by that Safe, which can only set the callback or renounce the role, not grant new token roles; earlier EOA/Safe token-admin grants are inactive. Protocol getAsset() is wstETH 0x7f39c581f595b53c5cb19bd0b3f8da6c935e2ca0 and its balance was 447.781841252339698684 wstETH: 100% of the configured collateral asset. Under the 2026-09-29 owner policy, only issuer/custodian-controlled collateral counts toward upstream freeze exposure; Lido DAO/protocol-governed stETH/wstETH does not, so the issuer/custodian-exposed reserve share is 0% and no inherited verdict resolves. Official deployment docs list Ethereum wUSDN 0x99999999999999cc837c997b882957dafdcb1af9, whose verified non-proxy wrapper points to this USDN and adds no holder-admin interface; no L2 USDN deployment is listed there. The refreshed false verdict agrees with the permissionless Safety Score transfer overlay.

oracleRisk.summary: USDN protocol actions and long-position liquidations use user-supplied Pyth prices with Chainlink fallback, but USDN itself is issued from a shared wstETH vault rather than borrower-specific debt positions.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1b oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: USDN protocol actions, including minting and redemption against the shared wstETH vault, require a user-supplied Pyth price validated through the protocol's oracle flow with fallback behavior. The same pricing also governs long-position liquidation, but USDN has no borrower-specific collateralized-debt markets requiring stablecoin branch rows.
